verdict.rationale: The Patents practice page documents named-practice prosecution work ("PTO-registered lawyers regularly help clients secure new patent rights") plus strong litigation/portfolio credentials (60+ patent trials, 155+ IPRs), supported by adjacent IP Counseling & Due Diligence and Trademark/Copyright group pages covering broader portfolio strategy and defensibility work. Missing for 10: named individual practitioner bios specifically tied to patent prosecution, and independent (non-firm) corroboration such as rankings or client testimonials for the patent practice.
